answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the horizon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
